observed_constraints: Dynamic symbol selection is the measured weak link while bounded semantic readability and symbol-axis writeout evidence are already strong.
Native llama.cpp cvec has bounded component support, but frozen structural label-free native v1 failed behaviorally; internal transport is therefore not equivalent to desired semantic binding.
The 123-run archive contains narrative and scalar evidence but no sample-level arrays sufficient to reconstruct the named hidden vectors exactly.
Swarm token volume is large while Distillery accepted dataset tokens remain zero; volume does not establish training utility.
Shared model-family, pipeline or orchestration ancestry and train/calibration/holdout provenance leakage collapse independence credit.
Training, model-specific J-Space, full HCU and whole EntityOS runtime credits remain zero.

purpose.goal: Teach evaluators, data filters and later separately tagged protocol examples to distinguish signal transport from correct binding, candidate evidence from fact, and causal identity from superficial success.

rounds.proposal: Treat any internally decodable or steerable signal as a positive J-Space binding example.
rounds.rejection: Frozen structural behavioral v1 falsifies the implication internal transport implies correct abstract binding.
rounds.repair: Separate TRANSPORT_PRESENT, BINDING_BEHAVIOR_PRESENT and CAUSAL_BINDING_VERIFIED labels.

rounds.proposal: Use the 123-run scalar summaries to synthesize missing named vectors.
rounds.rejection: Scalar and narrative evidence underdetermines sample-level vector arrays.
rounds.repair: Create BLOCKED_RAW_VECTOR_ABSENT hard negatives and require serializer or activation capture for future positives.

rounds.proposal: Convert high-volume Swarm output directly into positive training examples.
rounds.rejection: Measured token volume and nominal accepts do not establish Distillery admission or semantic utility.
rounds.repair: Positive dataset utility examples require evidence-qualified provenance plus exact accepted packet and token accounting.

rounds.proposal: Fuse corrected causal and epistemic hard negatives into the same target channel as the 72-row binder seed.
rounds.rejection: Mixing guard labels into the single-symbol binder target risks contaminating class-symbol counterbalance and teaches a second task implicitly.
rounds.repair: Keep this as a separate guard/evaluator family with shared provenance but separate target schema.

row_materialization_contract.split_law: Family and ancestry groups, not individual rows, are the minimum split unit. Paired counterfactuals stay in one split group.
row_materialization_contract.model_facing_law: Do not mix guard labels into the 72-row codebook SFT target channel. Use them for evaluator/filter training or separately tagged protocol examples.
row_materialization_contract.negative_sampling_law: Prefer negatives instantiated from observed project failures and blocked gates over invented generic mistakes.

architecture_feedback.proposal: Factor the learned interface into semantic-state representation, episode-local codebook/binding operator, and symbol writeout instead of a monolithic class-to-symbol mapping.
architecture_feedback.reason: Bounded semantic readability and writeout are already strong while dynamic mapping generalization is weak; behavioral failure despite internal transport points to binding/routing as the missing function.
architecture_feedback.falsifier: A binder-only intervention cannot improve cross-template remapping without degrading frozen semantic/readout retention.
architecture_feedback.training_implication: Weight mapping-flip counterfactuals and unseen-symbol/template transfer; penalize fixed associations.

architecture_feedback.proposal: Add a small explicit scope/epistemic prediction state with OBSERVED, INFERRED, BLOCKED and UNKNOWN plus claim-scope tags before canonical-effect translation.
architecture_feedback.reason: Many current failures are wrong promotion scope rather than wrong content: component to system, signal to binding, narrative to vector, volume to utility.
architecture_feedback.falsifier: Matched evaluation shows no reduction in false promotion on held-out failure families.
architecture_feedback.training_implication: Use F01-F09 as hard-negative supervision; this state must never mint canonical truth.

architecture_feedback.proposal: Represent replay-stable causal event identity separately from admission or route identity in the HCU/J-Space control ABI and train invariance/equivariance accordingly.
architecture_feedback.reason: The architecture already requires this identity split, while dynamic codebook tasks provide same-event different-route counterfactuals.
architecture_feedback.falsifier: The representation cannot keep event semantics invariant while correctly changing route-dependent symbol output on unseen mappings.
architecture_feedback.training_implication: Pair same-event mapping flips with route-invariant semantic probes and route-equivariant output targets.

acceptance_gates: Every failure family materializes at least one hard negative and one paired counterfactual with source ancestry.
No sample-level hidden vector is fabricated from scalar or narrative summaries.
No row converts token volume, model consensus, component PASS or stale authority into higher-scope credit.
Family and provenance ancestry split checks pass; paired counterfactuals never straddle splits.
The separate 72-row dynamic-binding seed remains class-symbol counterbalanced and uncontaminated by guard-label frequency.
Frozen retention and T5/unseen-symbol holdouts are selected before tuning.
Distillery accepted_dataset_tokens remains a measured gate; source-design rows alone keep training_credit=0.
Architecture hypotheses H1-H3 remain hypotheses until their declared falsifiers are run.
next_exact_action: Materialize validator-checked guard rows from F01-F10 alongside the separately preregistered 72-row dynamic-binding seed, then prove family/ancestry split isolation before any training attempt.
